Getting started takes three steps

  1. Tell us about your practice

    Send a few details about your specialty, claim volume and what is getting in the way. Please leave out patient information.

  2. We review and call you

    We look over your details and call within one business day to talk through your billing setup.

  3. Get a written summary

    You receive a summary of what we discussed and our suggested next steps, with no obligation to continue.

Common questions

What does Empire Med Service do?

We handle medical billing, coding, accounts receivable follow-up, credentialing and coverage discovery for U.S. healthcare providers. You can use one service or hand us the full revenue cycle.

What is in the free assessment?

You tell us about your practice and billing setup, we review the details, and we call you within one business day. A written summary follows the conversation.

Are there setup fees or long-term contracts?

No. We do not charge setup fees or require a long-term contract.

Do you work with practices in my state?

Yes. We work with providers in all 50 states.

How do you protect patient information?

Our work is HIPAA-compliant. Please do not put patient details in our website forms. We set up a secure channel before any records are exchanged.
